title: プログラミングⅡ（再履修クラス）
subtitle: Programming II
educationalGoal:
In the first half, students are going to learn basic Python programming and to acquire to write various programs subsequent to the precedent course, i.e., Programming I.
In the latter half, students are going to lean basic Java programming that requires compiling and static typing variables, to write simple programs, and to execute Java programs.
advice:
In this class, students learn two programming languages. In the first half, students learn basic Python programming subsequent to the precedent class, i.e., Programming I. In the latter half, students learn basic of programming with compiling and static typing variables, by using Java with comparing with Python.

Contents of Python:
(1) Data containers such as dictionary and set
(2) Concept of object, and class
(3) Programming with iterators that is the mechanism of accessing stored data
(4) Writing complicated programs using file I/O or exceptions

Contents of Java:
(1) The basic of writing Java program and executing programs
(2) Concept of variables with typing
(3) The grammar of Java and typical programming method for Java
requiredKnowledge:
The precedent course: Programming I
- Students have to bring own laptop computer, AC adopter, and network cable for software installation, download of course materials, and upload of answer of quizzes
- PC operation skills (such as touch typing, file operation, etc.) are necessary to write program smoothly

activityGoals.body: Be able to write Python programs using objects
Be able to write Python programs operating data in data structure using iterator appropriately
Be able to write Python programs operating file I/O
Be able to explain necessary operations step by step to execute Java programs
Be able to write Java programs using typing of variables appropriately
Be able to write Java programs using flow controls such as if, for, and while, and/or method

achievementLevels.ideal:
In addition to standard achievement level,
(1+) Be able to write Python programs using appropriate objects
(2+) Be able to write Python programs appropriately using list comprehension or itertools module
(3+) Be able to write Python programs appropriately useing text file I/O

(4+) Be able to fix errors in compiling Java programs
(9) Be able tor write Java programs with non-complicated specifications
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Be able to operate objects in Python
(2) Be able to use the iterator and list comprehension in Python
(3) Be able to operate text file in Python
(4) Be able to write and execute Java program
(5) Be able to write variable declaration, assignment to variables, and type conversion in Java
(6) Be able to write Java programs using conditional branches
(7) Be able to write Java programs using loops
(8) Be able to write Java programs with methods
